code_reference: Ch. 138, Art. IV — Landscaping & Tree Protection (Pinellas County Land Development Code)

perimeter_buffers._description: Buffer type required depends on the zoning of the subject property and the adjacent land use. Type A is least intensive, Type C is most intensive.

type_A.label: Type A Buffer
type_A.notes: Minimum 5-foot wide planting strip with 1 canopy or understory tree per 100 linear feet and a continuous shrub hedge.

type_B.label: Type B Buffer
type_B.notes: Minimum 10-foot wide planting strip with 2 canopy trees per 100 linear feet and a continuous shrub hedge.

type_C.label: Type C Buffer
type_C.notes: Minimum 15-foot wide planting strip with 3 canopy trees per 100 linear feet, continuous shrub hedge, and opaque wall or berm.

adjacency_matrix._description: Required buffer type based on subject zoning category vs adjacent land use category.

parking_lot_landscaping.code_reference: Sec. 138-3800 — Landscape Requirements for Parking Areas

interior_islands.rule: 1 landscape island per 10 contiguous parking spaces
interior_islands.notes: Each interior island must contain at least one canopy tree and groundcover or shrubs.

perimeter_strip.rule: 5-foot landscape strip required along all parking lot perimeters abutting a right-of-way or adjacent property

canopy_trees.rule: Minimum 1 canopy tree per 10 parking spaces
canopy_trees.notes: Trees may be located in interior islands or perimeter strips.

residential.notes: 25% canopy coverage measured at 15 years post-installation.

commercial.notes: 15% canopy coverage measured at 15 years post-installation.

industrial.notes: 10% canopy coverage measured at 15 years post-installation.

heritage_trees.description: Heritage trees (24 inches DBH or greater) are protected and require mitigation if removed.
heritage_trees.mitigation: Replacement trees or payment into the County's tree bank fund at the rate specified in Sec. 138-3801.

specimen_trees.description: Specimen trees (18 inches DBH or greater) require a tree removal permit.

irrigation.notes: All required landscape areas shall be served by an automatic underground irrigation system with rain sensor/shutoff device per Florida Statutes.
irrigation.drought_tolerant_exemption: 100% Florida-Friendly or xeriscape plantings may be exempt from irrigation requirements per Ch. 138.

sight_triangles.notes: No plant material between 3 and 8 feet in height is permitted within the sight triangle at intersections and driveway aprons.

plant_materials.notes: At least 75% of required plant material shall be Florida-Friendly species. Invasive species as listed by FDEP/IFAS are prohibited.
